passages.note: House Third Reading roll call recording Martinez's Yea vote on HB2853 (2022).

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Enacted bill text adding A.R.S. §15-2401.01, expanding ESA eligibility to nearly all Arizona students.
Bill status page lists Martinez as a co-sponsor of HB2853 (2022).

rows.reasoning: Martinez co-sponsored and voted Yea on HB2853 (2022), which added A.R.S. §15-2401.01 making ESA eligibility available to any Arizona resident eligible to enroll in a public preschool-disability program, kindergarten, or grades one through twelve who did not already qualify — in effect universal eligibility. This single-subject bill's operative clause matches rung 5, "Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family," since ESA funds are used at nongovernmental qualified schools chosen by the family.
